segments.name: pharmaceutical manufacturing and selling
segments.description: Manufactures and sells pharmaceutical products in China, the company's only operating segment.
segments.evidence: For management purposes, the Company operates in one business unit based on the products sold, and its sole operating segment is pharmaceutical manufacturing and selling.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay the Company for pharmaceutical products when they are sold and delivered.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's accounts receivable primarily includes the balance due from customers when the Company's pharmaceutical products are sold and delivered to customers.
